Amiri Decree No. (14) of 2023
Concerning Some Members of the Board of
Directors of Zayed Higher Organisation for People of
Determination
We, Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Ruler of Abu Dhabi,
Having reviewed:
• Law No. (1) of 1974 concerning the reorganisation of the Governmental
body in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi and its amendments;
• Law No. (2) of 2004 concerning the establishment of Zayed Higher
Organisation for Humanitarian Care, Special Needs and Minors Affairs
and its amendments;
• Amiri Decree No. (2) of 2020 concerning the reformation of the Board of
Directors of Zayed Higher Organisation for People of Determination; and
• Based on what was presented to and approved by the Executive Council;
Issued the following Decree:
Article (1)
The following members shall be appointed to the Board of Directors of Zayed
Higher Organisation for People of Determination:
• H.E. Mansour Ibrahim Ahmed Saeed Al Mansouri instead of H.E. Sheikh/
Abdullah bin Mohammed Al Hamed.
• H.E. Mubarak Hamad Mubarak Al Muhairi instead of H.E. Amer Hussein
Al Hamadi.
• H.E. Dr. Salem Khalfan Salem Al Kaabi instead of H.E. Abdullah Abdul
Hamid Al Sahi.
Article (2)
This Decree shall be effective from the date of its issuance and published in
the Official Gazette.
Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan
Ruler of Abu Dhabi
Issued by us in Abu Dhabi
On: 25 July 2023
Corresponding to: 7 Muharram 1445 Hijri

Executive Council Resolution No. (107) of 2023
concerning the Thirty-Second Investment Zone in the
Emirate of Abu Dhabi
The Executive Council has decided the following:
1. Approve the transfer of the land whose dimensions are specified in the
(attachment) to this Resolution to the Thirty-Second Investment Zone in
the Emirate of Abu Dhabi for the Ramhan Island project, provided that the
percentage of foreign ownership does not exceed (25%) in accordance
with the controls determined by the Department of Municipalities and
Transport.
2. Instruct Department of Municipalities and Transport to take the necessary
measures in conformity with the applicable regulations.
Saif Saeed Ghobash
Secretary-General
Issuance Date: 12 July 2023
Corresponding to: 24 Thu Al Hejjah 1444 Hijri

Executive Council Resolution No. (117) of 2023
Concerning the Additional Competencies of the
Department of Government Support
The Executive Council has decided the following:
1. The Department of Government Support shall assume the following
additional competencies:
• Develop and update innovative programmes and initiatives as well as
the standards of excellence of governmental services, in coordination
with the concerned entities, and supervise their implementation.
• Measure and follow up on the level of customer satisfaction and
experience as well as the level of performance of government services
provided, and submit periodic reports to the Executive Council including
plans and proposals to develop and improve the performance level of
such services.
• Supervise the improvement and development of the customer
experience in the Emirate to make it an easy and effortless experience,
and take the necessary measures, including the direct communication
with users of government services and beneficiaries therefrom, in
accordance with applicable legislations.
2. Instruct you to coordinate with Abu Dhabi Executive Office to determine
the movables, assets, rights and obligations related to the competencies
aforesaid in the previous clause of this Resolution, that are to be
transferred from the Office to the Department of Government Support.
3. Approve the transfer of Abu Dhabi Executive Office’s employees whose
work is related to the competencies aforesaid in Clause (1) of this
Resolution to the Department of Government Support, without prejudice
to their financial and retirement allocations.
4. Approve the transfer and conversion of budgets allocated for the
competencies aforesaid in Clause (1) of this Resolution and related
11

operations for the year 2023 from Abu Dhabi Executive Office to the
Department of Government Support.
5. Instruct you to coordinate with the Department of Finance to include the
amounts required within the budget preparation cycle of the Department
for the following years in accordance with the applicable regulations.
6. nstruct the Department of Finance to take the necessary measures in
conformity with the applicable regulations.
7. Any provision provided for in the Executive Council Resolution No. (180)
of 2019 concerning the Additional Competencies of Abu Dhabi Executive
Office and that is contrary to the provisions of this Resolution shall be
repealed.
Saif Saeed Ghobash
Secretary-General
Issuance Date: 17 July 2023
Corresponding to: 29 Thu Al Hejjah 1444 Hijri

Executive Council Resolution No. (122) of 2023
concerning the Additional Competencies of Abu Dhabi
Public Health Centre
The Executive Council has decided the following:
1. Abu Dhabi Public Health Centre shall assume the following additional
competencies:
• Manage and organize the public health pest control services in the
Emirate.
• Develop and implement the programmes and activities related to public
health pest control and conduct the necessary studies in this regard.
• Propose legislations and standards regulating the field of public health
pest control and submit them to the Department.
• License and supervise all the entities, companies and persons working
in the field of public health pest control and monitor the extent of their
commitment to providing the optimum level of quality of the services
they provide, in accordance with the applicable legislations.
2. Entrust the Chairman of Department of Health with the issuance of the
resolutions required for the implementation of the provisions of this
Resolution.
3. Instruct the Department of Health and Abu Dhabi Public Health Centre, in
coordination with the Department of Municipalities and Transport and the
relevant entities, to assume the following:
• Identify and transfer the assets, movables, properties, rights, and
obligations to combat public health pests to the Centre.
• Transfer the employees whose work is related to the practice of public
health pest control to Abu Dhabi Public Health Centre without prejudice
to their financial and retirement allocations.
• Develop a transitional plan to ensure the implementation of the
provisions of this Resolution and the continuity of operations of
public health pest control, provided that the transfer of all operations
15

is completed within six months from the date of issuance of this
Resolution.
4. Approve the transfer of all the budgets allocated to the competency
referred to in Clause (1) and the related operations for the year 2023 to
Abu Dhabi Public Health Centre, including the budgets allocated to the
salaries and entitlements of the transferred employees as well as the
relevant contracts and agreements.
5. Instruct the Department of Finance to take the necessary measures in
accordance with the applicable regulations.
Saif Saeed Ghobash
Secretary-General
Issuance Date: 31 July 2023
Corresponding to: 13 Muharram 1445 Hijri

Executive Council Resolution No. (149) of 2023
Concerning the Amendment of the Governmental
Fees On Hotel Establishments
The Executive Council has decided the following:
1. Tourism fees on hotel establishments shall be amended according to the
following:
• Tourism fee equal to (4%) of the invoice value issued to the customer.
• Municipality fee equal to (4%) of the invoice value issued to the
customer.
• Cancel the Municipality Room Fee (15 dirhams) per night for each
room.
2. The Tourism Fee of (6%) and the Municipality Fee of (4%) imposed on hotel
restaurants shall be cancelled.
3. Instruct the Chairman of the Department of Culture and Tourism to
proceed with the procedures for amending the Executive Regulations
of the control the revenues of tourist and hotel establishments in the
Emirate of Abu Dhabi in accordance with what was stated above, and to
issue them in accordance with the applicable regulations.
Saif Saeed Ghobash
Secretary-General
Issuance Date: 31 July 2023
Corresponding to: 13 Muharram 1445 Hijri
